description: This file defines the ElementHandle class, which represents an interactive handle to a DOM element in a browser automation context. It includes methods for querying, interacting, and inspecting DOM elements, including actions like click, fill, hover, screenshot, and evaluating scripts on the element.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a DOM element in the browser, providing methods for interaction, attribute access, and evaluation within the context of the page.
